a: PTouchLabelDemo hides the Download button's result and errors wherever printing is unavailable
MermaidKindsDemo leaves a failed parse as an unhandled rejection and keeps showing the previous diagram
MenuDemo's menu items sit in a plain `<ul>`, so they are not owned by the `role="menu"` container, and the highlight is never exposed
MeasureLabDemo keeps one `Measurements` store across trial scenes, so a measurement picked in one trial stays picked in the next
b: LevelOfDetailDemo stores its cards in world coordinates under a rigid group frame, so every container but the first draws its cards at twice its offset
ParallaxDemo's tree parts are posed in world coordinates under their group, so since rigid composition became the default the trees draw at twice their position, off the bottom of the stage
MermaidKindsDemo lets a parse failure escape: a synchronous throw from `read` crashes the effect, an async rejection is unhandled and leaves the previous kind's diagram shown
PTouchLabelDemo's preview effect drops a `renderLabel` rejection unhandled, while its buttons route the same call's failures to the status line
